content.taskSummary: Assess whether the read-only explorer can update a deployment.
constraints: Repository and deployment writes are unavailable.

subgoals.question: Can the deployment be updated?
subgoals.proofCondition: Perform the requested deployment write if the configured image is stale.
constraints: Do not claim that a write occurred.

goals.reason: The explorer is read-only and has no repository or deployment write capability.
